build_order_basis: Wave 1 starts with fixed serial arms that can plausibly reuse the existing arm_serial_dls family, beginning with Franka Panda, then Kinova Gen3 and xArm7, followed by the other fixed arms.
Wave 2 covers the articulated hand, quadruped, and humanoid morphologies after the fixed-arm package pattern is understood.
Wave 3 covers the mobile manipulator, bimanual, and legged-arm morphologies, which require broader coordination or locomotion interfaces.
